moodys.citation_text: UNVERIFIED — Moody's maintains a credit-rating landing page for 'Steward Health Care System LLC' but the page is paywalled / 403 to anonymous fetch. The last publicly searchable Moody's rating actions found (via Becker's and Moody's PR archive) are the 2014 outlook change to stable on a B3 CFR and a 2016 upgrade to B2; no public rating actions in 2017-2024 were locatable via WebSearch/WebFetch. Steward operated as a private, PE-owned (Cerberus, then management buyout) entity and is widely characterized as having relied on private financing rather than rated public debt during the snapshot window. As of 2022-12-31 the existence of an active Moody's CFR cannot be verified from primary sources without subscription access.

sp.citation_text: UNVERIFIED — The only publicly indexed S&P action on Steward Health Care System LLC found was 'Steward Health Care System LLC Assigned "B" Corporate Credit Rating; New Debt Rated; Outlook Stable - 2013/03/28' (Alacra Store / S&P Global Ratings Credit Research). No S&P research item indexed for the 2022-2025 window was located via WebSearch. S&P did downgrade Steward's landlord Medical Properties Trust to sub-investment grade citing Steward distress, but that is a counterparty rating, not Steward's own. As of 2022-12-31 the existence of an active S&P issuer rating on Steward cannot be verified from primary sources.

fitch.citation_text: UNVERIFIED — No Fitch rating action on Steward Health Care System LLC was located via WebSearch for any year. Steward appears not to have been rated by Fitch at the issuer level.

rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: UNVERIFIED — No Moody's rating actions on Steward Health Care System LLC in the 2023-01-01 to 2025-03-31 window could be located via WebSearch/WebFetch from primary sources. Becker's Hospital Review article 'Moody's Confidence in Steward Slips' was returned in search results but the page returns HTTP 403 to anonymous WebFetch, preventing primary-source citation of any specific rating change.

UNVERIFIED — No S&P rating actions on Steward Health Care System LLC itself in the 2023-01-01 to 2025-03-31 window were located. S&P actions in this period referenced Steward only indirectly, as the largest tenant of Medical Properties Trust.

bankruptcy_event.court: United States Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of Texas
bankruptcy_event.citation_text: On May 6, 2024, Steward Health Care System LLC and 166 of its affiliated debtors each filed a voluntary petition for relief under Chapter 11 of the United States Bankruptcy Code in the United States Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of Texas. The cases are jointly administered under Case No. 24-90213 before the Honorable Christopher M. Lopez. (Kroll Restructuring Administration case site, the court-appointed claims agent, restructuring.ra.kroll.com/Steward).

corroborating_sources.citation_text: Steward Health Care filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy on Monday morning, May 6, 2024, in federal court in Texas; the company stated it had 'secured $75 million in initial funding to support the Chapter 11 reorganization' and did not expect any interruptions in day-to-day operations.
Steward Health filed Chapter 11 in the Southern District of Texas; the company listed assets and liabilities of $1 billion to $10 billion (Bloomberg Law).

Steward Health Care System filed for Chapter 11 on May 6, 2024 with approximately $9.2 billion of liabilities; the plan was later confirmed by Judge Christopher M. Lopez of the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of Texas (Weil, Gotshal & Manges LLP, debtors' counsel).

outcome_class_rationale: Chapter 11 filed 2024-05-06 in S.D. Tex. (Case No. 24-90213, Judge Christopher M. Lopez) — one of the largest hospital-system bankruptcies in U.S. history. Filing date is verified by three independent sources (Kroll case site, WGBH, Bloomberg Law) and the debtors' counsel (Weil Gotshal). Outcome class is DEFAULT regardless of pre-filing rating-agency coverage. Caveat: Steward operated as a privately-held, PE-owned entity that, based on available primary-source evidence, does not appear to have had active issuer-level ratings from Moody's, S&P, or Fitch during the 2022-2025 window; the last publicly searchable agency actions on the entity were Moody's outlook/CFR actions in 2014-2016. All starting/ending rating fields are therefore marked UNVERIFIED rather than fabricated. For muni-credit backtest purposes the DEFAULT label is correctly assigned via the bankruptcy event itself.
